high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the artist santanu_hazarika_art, located in Mumbai, Maharashtra. The post features a detailed and stylized illustration of a mechanical or robotic figure with a human-like head. The head appears to be melting or deforming, with pink, liquid-like tendrils extending from it, giving it a surreal and somewhat unsettling appearance. The figure has sharp teeth and a wide-open mouth, adding to the eerie effect. The text accompanying the image reads: "The silent scream machine is in motion.
